explanation: I found no single Mathlib declaration stating (χ.comp φ).ker = H ⊔ φ.ker from χ.ker = H.map φ. The proof combines two Mathlib lemmas: AddMonoidHom.comap_ker (additive form of MonoidHom.comap_ker, Subgroup/Ker.lean:274) and AddSubgroup.comap_map_eq (additive form of Subgroup.comap_map_eq, line 448). The Ker.lean ker_comp lemmas I found cover only the equivalence and injective cases (ker_comp_mulEquiv, ker_comp_of_injective). I also grepped Mathlib/Algebra/Group for other ker-comp and comap_map statements and found nothing closer.
